name: What are common signs that the siding around my windows needs replacement?

mainEntity.name: What are common signs that the siding around my windows needs replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Look for visible signs of damage such as cracking, warping, blistering, or soft spots in the siding directly surrounding your windows. Discoloration, peeling paint, or mold growth near window frames often indicate moisture penetration. Inside your home, drafts, water stains on window sills or walls, and increased energy bills can also signal compromised siding. Addressing these issues promptly can prevent more extensive and expensive repairs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common signs include cracking, warping, soft spots, mold, peeling paint, drafts, or water stains near windows.
